title: Megan Thee Stallion Is the Big Boss of Netflix’s KShop In New Campaign: Exclusive First Look
summary: The chart-topping Texas hip-hop star flexes her acting chops in a new custom ad for "KPop Demon Hunters" merch.
contentText:
For her next flex, Megan Thee Stallion works the register and calls all the shots in The KShop.

The chart-topping Texas hip-hop star flaunts her acting chops in a custom ad for KPop Demon Hunters merch , which will go to air tonight (Nov. 25) during the NFL Thanksgiving Eve game on Netflix.

Megan isn’t your regular shopkeeper. She’s an unmovable force, a heavyweight champion of sass who simply can’t be outwitted as a stream of customers try to cut a deal on her inventory.

A demonic BEEF actor Charles Melton and NFL Hall of Famer Michael Irvin are among the walk-ins who try their luck on the fandom’s goodies, which includes Kayou trading cards , Mattel Singing Dolls , Hasbro Light Sticks , the LEGO Derpy Tiger and Sussie Bird set. Superfans will spot other treasures on the shelves.

This is not your regularly store, and these aren’t your typical buyers.

A creation of Netflix’s Brand Creative Studio, the mini-episode and others will roll out on the KShopDemonHunters Instagram channel. Your precious KShop merch awaits at the online stores of Kayou , Mattel , Hasbro , Vans and LEGO .

The pairing of Megan Thee Stallion with KPop Demon Hunters should be a winning combination. Megan is a star in her game with three career No. 1s on the Billboard Hot 100, and 45 total tracks on the singles chart. Her collection of accolades include four American Music Awards, four MTV Video Music Awards, three Grammy Awards, a Billboard Women in Music Award, and, in 2019, the Powerhouse Award at the 2019 Billboard Women in Music ceremony.

The Houston Hottie has been heating up ahead of her Act III album. She’s dropped a trio of Tina Tuesday Freestyles, including the standout “Thin Ice,” which reached a new peak of No. 64 on the Billboard Hot 100 in its second week on the chart. And keep an eye out for her return as Denise for the season 2 finale of The Fall and Rise of Reggie Dinkins on NBC, which will beam out sometime in early 2027.

Since it premiered on Netflix in June 2025, KPop Demon Hunters  has crushed records for fun . Following the fictional girl group HUNTR/X as its members Rumi, Mira and Zoey bring the fight to the evil demons of this world, the animated film and its official soundtrack has been a monster hit. 

Just two months after it premiered, KPop Demon Hunters became Netflix’s most-watched film of all time, surpassing 236 million total views. Its standout song “Golden” spent eight weeks at No. 1 on the Billboard Hot 100 , and is one of four original songs from the film to crack the top 10 on the Billboard Hot 100, a first for a soundtrack. Then, at the February 2026 Grammy Awards, “Golden” made history as the first K-pop song to win a golden gramophone, taking home best song written for visual media.

The following month, in March 2026, Billboard announced that HUNTR/X singers EJAE, AUDREY NUNA and REI AMI would be sharing the title of Woman of the Year at the Women in Music Awards, making them the first group to collectively win the honor. In the same month, “Golden” became the first K-pop track to ever win an Oscar, doing so for best original song. “Golden” previously won the same category at both the Golden Globes and Critic’s Choice Awards.
